from micropython import const
from time import sleep_us

FUNCTION_SET = const(0x20)
DISPLAY_CONTROL = const(0x08)
SET_Y_ADDRESS = const(0x40)
SET_X_ADDRESS = const(0x80)
TEMP_COEFF = const(0x04)
BIAS_SYSTEM = const(0x10)
SET_VOP = const(0x80)
EXTENDED_INSTR = const(0x01)
ADDRESSING_VERT = const(0x02)
DISPLAY_NORMAL = const(0x04)
BIAS_1_40 = const(4)
TEMP_COEFF_2 = const(2)

WIDTH = const(84)
HEIGHT = const(48)


class PCD8544:
    def __init__(self, spi, cs, dc, rst=None):
        self.spi = spi
        self.cs = cs
        self.dc = dc
        self.rst = rst
        self.cs.init(self.cs.OUT, value=1)
        self.dc.init(self.dc.OUT, value=0)
        if self.rst:
            self.rst.init(self.rst.OUT, value=1)
        self.reset()
        self.init()

    def init(self, horizontal=True, contrast=0x3F, bias=BIAS_1_40, temp=TEMP_COEFF_2):
        self.fn = FUNCTION_SET | (0 if horizontal else ADDRESSING_VERT)
        self.write_cmd(self.fn | EXTENDED_INSTR)
        self.write_cmd(TEMP_COEFF | temp)
        self.write_cmd(BIAS_SYSTEM | bias)
        self.write_cmd(SET_VOP | contrast)
        self.write_cmd(self.fn)
        self.write_cmd(DISPLAY_CONTROL | DISPLAY_NORMAL)
        self.clear()

    def reset(self):
        if self.rst:
            self.rst(1)
            sleep_us(100)
            self.rst(0)
            sleep_us(100)
            self.rst(1)

    def write_cmd(self, command):
        self.dc(0)
        self.cs(0)
        self.spi.write(bytearray([command]))
        self.cs(1)

    def data(self, buf):
        self.dc(1)
        self.cs(0)
        self.spi.write(buf)
        self.cs(1)

    def position(self, x, y):
        self.write_cmd(SET_X_ADDRESS | x)
        self.write_cmd(SET_Y_ADDRESS | y)

    def clear(self):
        self.position(0, 0)
        self.data(bytearray(WIDTH * HEIGHT // 8))
        self.position(0, 0)

from machine import Pin, SPI
import framebuf, time
import pcd8544
spi = SPI(1, baudrate=2000000, polarity=0, phase=0, sck=Pin({CLK}), mosi=Pin({DIN}))
lcd = pcd8544.PCD8544(spi, Pin({CE}), Pin({DC}), Pin({RST}))
buf = bytearray(84 * 48 // 8)
fb = framebuf.FrameBuffer(buf, 84, 48, framebuf.MONO_VLSB)
n = 0
while True:
    fb.fill(0)
    fb.text('Count', 0, 0, 1)
    fb.text(str(n), 0, 16, 1)
    lcd.data(buf)
    n += 1
    time.sleep(1)
